create_local_action_server: create a LocalActionServer instance to manage thread-safe action state transitions
cancel_goal_preempt: call cancel_goal on a LocalActionServer to set state to PREEMPTING
check_action_availability: use is_available on a LocalActionServer to check if the action server is free
get_action_state: call get_state on a LocalActionServer to retrieve the current thread-safe state value
review_local_action_status: review the LocalActionStatus class constants for ACTIVE, PREEMPTED, SUCCEEDED, ABORTED, FREE, PREEMPTING, DISABLED
